newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to build ships worth $1.5 bln in 1997 - PM.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to build ships worth $1.5 bln in 1997 - PM.

text.p: Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan said Turkey planned to build ships worth a total $1.5 billion in 1997, the state-run Anatolian news agency reported.
Speaking at a ceremony to launch a container ship from a shipyard near Istanbul, Erbakan noted that the country's 41 shipyards built ships worth just $30 million in 1996.
"But in 1997, ships worth $1.5 billion will be produced. We will operate our shipyards at full capacity," Erbakan said.
He said the state would support the domestic industry by encouraging banks to guarantee ship-building projects, sharing the risk between the state and the private sector.
